criterion: MODEL EFFICIENCY verdict: our model sits ON-CURVE if its CAGR is within ±20% (in log terms) of the ladder interpolation at its own realized RankIC — conclusion: the binding constraint is INFORMATION, and improvement means new data, not new architecture. It sits BELOW-CURVE if lower than that band — conclusion: TRANSLATION slack exists in the signal→book layer, quantified as the CAGR gap. Mechanical, no post-hoc adjustment.
